claim_boundary: V19AX is an image acquisition and geometric/integrity audit, not a source measurement.
Opening pixels to verify FITS structure, WCS, dimensions, finite values and weight support does not authorize flux measurement at any anchor or candidate position.
The acquired coadds do not establish that a candidate is a cluster member and do not create a baryonic mass map.
A pass authorizes a separately frozen development-anchor photometry and crowded-field deblending comparison; it does not authorize candidate interpretation, mass, lensing, halo or gravity claims.
failure: The frozen acquisition runner stopped when the g-band weight plane had less than 99% positive support.

post_failure_optimistic_union.definition: Candidate-center positive coadd weight in all griz OR prior V19AV signed-stack SNR >= 3 in all griz. This is an upper-bound support diagnostic, not a combined flux measurement.
